SELECT l.RNP, COUNT(*) AS records, MIN(l."Date") AS first_date,
       MAX(l."Date") AS last_date, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TYPEOF(l.CPK)) AS cpk_types
FROM main.Laboratory AS l
JOIN main.Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
GROUP BY l.RNP
ORDER BY records DESC

WITH ranked_measurements AS (
    SELECT l.RNP, l.CPK,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY l.ID
               ORDER BY l."Date" DESC
           ) AS recency
    FROM main.Laboratory AS l
    JOIN main.Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM ranked_measurements
WHERE recency = 1
  AND RNP <> 'negative'
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND CPK < 250
LIMIT 1
